name: Stonemaul Ruins
summary: Firemane dragonspawn hold Stonemaul Ruins, the old home of the Stonemaul ogres. Driven out by the black dragonflight, the clan fled north and left its village to the brood.

sections.title: Rise and Fall of the Clan Home
sections.body:
Stonemaul Village rose in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh after the ogres came to Kalimdor. The beastmaster Rexxar won their respect by surviving the clan's deadly trials, killing their chieftain Kor'gall, and rallying the ogres to defend the young Horde against Admiral Proudmoore's forces.

After the war, Rexxar left Mok'Morokk in command. But the ogre ruled for himself, and the village fell. Then the black dragonflight ambushed and shattered it. The survivors fled north and founded Brackenwall Village. Onyxia's brood claimed the ruins.

sections.title: The Struggle for Reclamation
sections.body: Firemane dragonspawn now infest the ruins in Dragonmurk and tend the brood's nearby nesting grounds. Overlord Mok'Morokk has grown cowardly and is content to remain in Brackenwall. Older, prouder clan members Tharg and Draz'Zilb refuse to give up their homeland. From Brackenwall, they urge Horde champions to kill the dragonspawn and smash the dragonflight's eggs. They hope the Stonemaul will march back and reclaim their ancestral village.

faq.q: Who used to live in Stonemaul Ruins?
faq.answer: The Stonemaul ogres built and lived in the settlement, then called Stonemaul Village, after they came to Kalimdor.
Onyxia's black dragonflight attacked the village and drove out the ogres. Firemane dragonspawn now use the ruins as a nesting outpost.

faq.q: Where did the surviving ogres go?
faq.answer: The survivors fled north into Dustwallow Marsh and founded Brackenwall Village under Overlord Mok'Morokk.

faq.q: What was Rexxar's connection to this place?
faq.answer: Rexxar came to enlist the ogres against Kul Tiras. He passed their trial, killed their tyrannical warlord Kor'gall, and briefly led the clan before handing command to Mok'Morokk.

faq.q: Do the ogres plan to retake the ruins?
faq.answer: Yes. Though Mok'Morokk is afraid to act, Stonemaul leaders Tharg and Draz'Zilb recruit Horde adventurers to kill the Firemane dragonspawn and prepare to retake their home.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you stand with Stonemaul ogres who fought beside Thrall's Horde against Kul Tiras. Helping them strike back at the black dragonflight honors that pact.
